No spam - genuine quotes from vetted UK engine specialists only. 8,000+ Engine Codes 40+ Car Brands 100% Free · No Obligation Make Select Make Series Model Select a model Year Select Model First Engine Code Get Free Engine Quotes At a glance · what your stalling means Match the stalling pattern to the likely cause Stalls when stopping (at lights/junctions) Idle air control valve or vacuum leak Medium £100-£400 Stalls when accelerating Fuel pump or fuel delivery Medium £150-£900 Stalls randomly (no pattern) Crank/cam sensor or ECU Medium £100-£1,200+ Stalls when cold Coolant temp sensor Low-Medium £80-£200 Stalls after starting, then runs Immobiliser issue Medium £100-£400 What this usually means in UK cars Engine stalling is frustrating and dangerous When your engine stalls while driving, you lose power steering and brake assistance - making the car difficult to control. In our 24,650 quote dataset, we identified five primary patterns: Stalls when stopping - 30% of cases Idle air control valve or vacuum leak. Repair: £100-£400. Stalls when accelerating - 25% of cases Fuel pump or fuel pressure. Repair: £150-£900. Stalls randomly - 20% of cases Crank/cam position sensor. Repair: £100-£300. Stalls when cold - 15% of cases Coolant temperature sensor. Repair: £80-£200. Stalls after starting - 10% of cases Immobiliser or ECU. Repair: £100-£1,200+. The critical safety warning: If your engine stalls while driving, power steering and brake assistance are lost. The car is still controllable but requires significantly more effort to steer and stop. Common affected vehicles & engines Stalling issues by make and model Vehicle Common Engine Code Typical Stalling Issue Cost Range VW Golf / Audi A3 EA888 2.0 TSI PCV valve failure £150-£350 BMW 3-Series (E90) N43/N53 2.0 High-pressure fuel pump £400-£900 Ford Focus 1.6/2.0 TDCi Fuel pressure sensor £150-£400 Vauxhall Astra 1.6/2.0 CDTi EGR valve £300-£600 Mini Cooper N14 1.6 Crank sensor £100-£300 Audi A4 / A6 EA113 2.0 TFSI Idle control valve £100-£300 Mercedes C-Class M271 1.8 Cam sensor £140-£330 Land Rover Freelander 2.0 TDCi Fuel pump (LR known issue) £400-£900 What people think vs reality The expensive mistake is assuming it's a simple fix ✕ “It's just a dirty throttle body - easy fix.” Sometimes. But in 70% of cases, it's a sensor or fuel issue. ✕ “I'll just turn the key and carry on.” If the ECU has a fault, it will keep stalling. You're masking the problem. ✕ “Stalling is normal in cold weather.” No. Cold weather can highlight the problem but it's not normal. ✕ “A fuel cleaner will fix it.” Rarely. Most stalling is sensor or valve failure, not dirt. Diagnostic flowchart Follow this decision tree to identify the cause ENGINE STALLING │ ├─── When does it stall? │ │ │ ├── When stopping → Idle air valve or vacuum │ │ │ │ │ ├── EML on? → Sensor → Sensor failure │ │ │ │ │ └── No EML → Vacuum leak → Vacuum leak │ │ │ ├── When accelerating → Fuel system │ │ │ │ │ ├── Fuel pump → Fuel pump │ │ │ │ │ └── Fuel filter → Fuel filter │ │ │ ├── Random (no pattern) → Sensors │ │ │ │ │ ├── Crank sensor → Crank sensor │ │ │ │ │ └── Cam sensor → Cam sensor │ │ │ ├── When cold → Coolant temp sensor → Temp sensor │ │ │ └── After starting → Immobiliser/ECU → Immobiliser / ECU Stalling types & repair costs Use the symptom pattern to understand the repair range Symptom Pattern What It Means Typical Repair Cost Range Stalls when stopping Idle air valve or vacuum leak Valve clean/replacement £100-£400 Stalls when accelerating Fuel pump or delivery Fuel pump replacement £150-£900 Stalls randomly (no pattern) Crank/cam sensor Sensor replacement £100-£300 Stalls randomly + EML ECU or major sensor Diagnostic + repair £200-£1,200+ Stalls when cold Coolant temp sensor Sensor replacement £80-£200 Stalls after starting then runs Immobiliser/ECU ECU repair or replacement £100-£1,200+ Stalls + rough idle Multiple causes Full diagnostic £100-£2,000+ ⚠️ Safety warning - stalling while driving If your engine stalls while driving: ✅ DO: Keep the steering straight · Brake firmly but avoid sudden stops · Put the car in neutral and restart if safe · Pull over to a safe location ❌ DON'T: Panic - the car is still controllable · Drive far if it keeps stalling Loss of power steering and brake assistance: When the engine stalls, the power steering pump and brake servo stop working. The car becomes significantly harder to steer and stop. Allow extra distance for braking. Don't delay diagnosis. What to do next Note the pattern, then diagnose Step 1: Note the stalling pattern When does it stall? (stopping, accelerating, random, cold, after start). This is the most important diagnostic clue. Step 2: Check for warning lights EML on? Check Engine Light? These indicate sensor or ECU issues. Step 3: Professional diagnostic (£50-£150) A technician will read fault codes, check live data (fuel trims, sensors), test fuel pressure, and inspect idle control and vacuum system. This includes fault code reading and basic inspection. Is a stalling engine dangerous? Yes - especially at speed. You lose power steering and brake assistance. Pull over safely as soon as possible. Can a dirty throttle body cause stalling? Yes - but it's less common than sensor or fuel system failure. A throttle body clean is often the first diagnostic step. Can a fuel filter cause stalling? Yes. A blocked fuel filter restricts fuel flow, causing stalling under acceleration or at speed.

blocks.question: How much does engine stalling diagnosis cost in the UK?
blocks.answer: £50-£150 at UK independent garages. This includes fault code reading and basic inspection.

blocks.question: Is a stalling engine dangerous?
blocks.answer: Yes - especially at speed. You lose power steering and brake assistance. Pull over safely as soon as possible.

blocks.question: Can a dirty throttle body cause stalling?
blocks.answer: Yes - but it's less common than sensor or fuel system failure. A throttle body clean is often the first diagnostic step.

blocks.question: Can a fuel filter cause stalling?
blocks.answer: Yes. A blocked fuel filter restricts fuel flow, causing stalling under acceleration or at speed.
